content.title: Adam Sandler’s Kids, Sadie & Sunny, Have Been in Over 20 Movies Each – Full List Revealed!
content.text: Adam Sandler usually makes his movies a family affair with his wife Jackie and their daughters Sadie and Sunny all appearing in them, most of the time. In the new movie Roommates, produced by Adam, Sadie stars as a naive college freshman who becomes roommates with a cool and confident girl. They must face different obstacles of living in the same dorm together. Adam and Jackie, who met on the set of his 1999 movie Big Daddy, got married in Malibu in June 2003. They are parents to daughters Sadie, 19, and Sunny, 17. Both girls have been featured in more than 20 movies at this point, with Sunny even leading her own Netflix film a couple years ago. Now it’s Sadie‘s turn to lead her own film. Head inside to check out their filmographies… Check out their filmographies below!
